notes: Hand-picked for a trip to Tasmania (Hobart, Bruny Island, Maria Island, Eaglehawk Neck and its pelagics, Cradle Mountain, the south-west and Melaleuca). The AU trip already holds most Tasmanian endemics (Forty-spotted Pardalote, Yellow Wattlebird, Black Currawong, Dusky Robin, Tasmanian Scrubwren, Green Rosella, Tasmanian Nativehen, Swift Parrot) and the common pelagic seabirds; this pack adds the rest: Tasmanian Thornbill, Scrubtit, Strong-billed and Yellow-throated Honeyeater, Olive Whistler, Tasmanian Boobook, Orange-bellied and Ground Parrot, the island's winter and summer visitors, and the albatrosses, petrels, prions and storm-petrels of the Eaglehawk Neck pelagics.
